written_after: 5 forward days were logged (2026-10-22..28: +$697.90 on 1 MNQ). Those days count toward the checkpoints like any other; the rule below does not depend on them.
data: scripts/forward_log.py: Yahoo NQ=F 1-minute bars, RTH sessions from 2026-10-22, frozen SC-FUT-0005 rule, L3 costs, 1 MNQ, matched random-direction control (500 draws)
test: workbench paired test (stationary bootstrap, one-sided) of daily net vs the control mean, all scored days so far
alpha_note: O'Brien-Fleming-style spending, about 0.05 in total across the three looks
pass: p below that checkpoint's alpha AND mean net per day > 0: the edge is confirmed on fresh data; real-money prop attempts become reasonable
stop_for_harm: at any checkpoint, mean net per day <= -$5 (L3): stop treating SC-FUT-0005 as a candidate
between_checkpoints: running totals may be shown, but no decision (buy, stop, resize) is taken on them
caveat: Yahoo's continuous contract and data gaps differ slightly from the MNQ volume-roll backtest; days with fewer than 300 RTH bars are reported separately
